font.body.source: self-hosted Shopify CDN woff2/woff, not Google Fonts
font.heading.letter_spacing_content_bloc: -0.005em to -0.01em (used in advertorial/blog title & pill styling, not the theme global default)
font.accent.usage: header icon labels and product-card price text
font.sizes.note: h1-h4 are responsive; values above are the largest (desktop) breakpoint pulled from bundle.css. Body content blocks (buyer's-guide articles) instead use fixed px: article h2=23px/700, article h3=18px/700, body copy=17px (15.5px on mobile)
color.brand.primary_accent_note: Main site accent/button green (rgb 22,196,127). Used for buttons, star ratings, Judge.me widget, pill borders.
color.accent.red_note: Only red found in live CSS is the shipping-calculator error state (#c33b3b). Site has no red brand accent otherwise -- ads' 'red accent' is an ad-specific addition, not sourced from the theme.
color.accent.author_bio_gold_note: Secondary gold/tan accent used only on author bio pages (dark hero card), not the general site palette.
button.primary.border_radius: 0.2rem (2px) -- site's global round-level-1 setting, deliberately minimal
button.primary.hover: overlays rgba(255,255,255,.2) gradient on top of the bg color (subtle lighten), no color swap
button.secondary.style: outline variant: transparent bg, 1px solid border in accent color, text in accent color
button.secondary.hover: inset box-shadow 0 0 0 .1rem in the outline color (border thickens, no fill change)
layout.max_content_width_note: --gsc-large-container-width: 132rem = 1320px. Medium=1140px, small=960px, full-bleed page container=2560px (background only, not text width).
layout.container_padding_note: --gsc-container-padding: 4rem (40px) desktop; mobile uses min(aside-padding, 2rem) which is commonly 20px
layout.section_vertical_spacing_note: Per-section value set in the page builder; 48px was the most common observed value on the homepage. Some sections use 0/12/30/32px overrides. No single fixed system value -- treat 48px as the safe default and scale up ~1.5-2x for large hero-style sections.
layout.card_radius_theme_note: Global theme card/button/badge radius token (--gsc-*-radii) is 0.2rem = 2px, from round-level-1 body class.
layout.card_radius_content_blocks_note: Buyer's-guide/advertorial content blocks (table wrapper, byline box, trust box, bio tiles) consistently use 8-16px radius, not the theme's 2px. Use 8px for landing-page cards to match this established advertorial style, not the theme chrome.
layout.card_shadow: none observed on standard cards; author-bio photo uses 0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.35) as a deliberate portrait shadow only
trust.star_widget: Custom widget (.pk-rating/.pk-stars), not the raw Judge.me stars: 5 unicode stars (\2605) in #D8DAD5, with an absolutely-positioned overlay span colored #16C47F clipped to the fill percentage.
trust.pill_badge_example: "Best for X" pill on product pages: bg #E9F7F0, text #0E7A50, 1px border rgba(22,196,127,.35), radius 999px, padding 6px 13px, font-size 13px weight 700
trust.org_schema: Organization JSON-LD reports: Free shipping. Limited lifetime warranty on structure. Phone +14706653747, sales@peaksaunas.com
theme.name: Live Peak Saunas Site
